resolutions.phrase: The intake rota stays fortnightly, as agreed on 1 October, but the overlap call at each hand-off grows from fifteen to thirty minutes.

referents.why: Keeps the agreed fortnightly cadence from the 1 October call but changes the overlap call from fifteen to thirty minutes. This is a revision of one detail, not a replacement of the position.
Priya's statement is the source of both the fortnightly cadence and the fifteen-minute overlap call that this commentary adjusts.

resolutions.why: 'As agreed on 1 October' and 'fortnightly' with the overlap call duration match the single intake-rota position and its first expression. No other node competes.

referents.why: Gives the reason the fifteen-minute overlap call was too short, which adds a consequence to that statement.
